item.text:
**7B.7 Research Note**

Verdict: mixed, with no strong direct evidence that Lula personally ordered court-obstruction or investigator retaliation in 2024, but there are real caveats around information control, strategic-firm pressure, and tolerance of a suspect ally.

- **Lula says government does not interfere with the Federal Police or judiciary** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-01-30 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/01/30/lula-rebate-acusacoes-de-bolsonaro-sobre-operacao-da-pf.amp.htm) | Lula denied executive interference and said PF actions were under court orders. This is direct pro-accountability evidence, though self-serving. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.6
- **Lula backs investigation of the alleged coup plot** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-02-08 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/02/08/lula-diz-acreditar-que-nao-seria-possivel-tentativa-de-golpe-de-estado-sem-bolsonaro.htm) | He supported investigating the January 8 plot rather than shielding politically connected actors. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.6
- **Lula to nominate Gabriel Galípolo as central bank chief** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | [recoverable page](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764) | The pick was a serving central-bank monetary policy director with finance-ministry experience, which looks technocratic rather than loyalist. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.5, 7B.6
- **Lula's nominee to head Brazil central bank emphasizes freedom in decisionmaking** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-08 | [recoverable page](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/lulas-nominee-to-head-brazil-central-bank-emphasizes-freedom-in-decisionmaking-3653485) | Galípolo told senators Lula guaranteed him freedom in decision-making, which supports formal respect for expert autonomy. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.5, 7B.6
- **AGU notifies YouTube to remove false content about Lula's health** | Advocacia-Geral da União | 2024-12-16 | [recoverable page](https://www.gov.br/agu/pt-br/comunicacao/noticias/youtube-retira-do-ar-desinformacao-sobre-estado-de-saude-do-presidente-da-republica/) | The AGU used official legal notice to force removal of videos alleging Lula had died or was in worse condition than medical bulletins showed. This is the clearest state-power-to-manage reputation item, though framed as anti-disinformation. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.1, 7B.2
- **Brazil digital news report: fake-news bill and hourly-fine threat** | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | [recoverable page](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/brazil) | The report says the government’s platform bill was abandoned after a standoff in which the justice minister threatened an hourly fine when Google opposed the proposal. This is strong evidence of pressure on the information environment. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.1, 7B.2
- **TCU prosecutor seeks inquiry into possible Petrobras interference** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-03-18 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm) | The TCU prosecutor asked for an investigation into whether dividend decisions were driven by government preference rather than economics. This is the strongest caveat for concealed official decisions and strategic-firm steering. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.4, 7B.5, 7B.6
- **Lula pressured Petrobras dividend policy, then did not immediately remove an indicted minister** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-03-20 / 2024-06-13 | [recoverable page 1](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/20/fazenda-insiste-com-lula-por-aval-a-dividendo-extra-da-petrobras.amp.htm) and [recoverable page 2](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/13/lula-diz-que-tomara-decisao-sobre-juscelino-filho-e-que-indiciamento-nao-significa-que-ministro-cometeu-erro.amp.htm) | Reuters reported pressure on Lula to block extraordinary Petrobras dividends, and later reported he did not immediately remove Communications Minister Juscelino Filho after indictment in a Codevasf probe. Together, these are the best 2024 patronage/capture caveats. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.4, 7B.5, 7B.6
- **Brazil still lacked fully independent investigations of police killings** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-15 | [recoverable page](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence) | HRW said Brazil had not fully implemented independent-investigation requirements and that police killings were still often investigated by police themselves. This is more an institutional weakness than proof of Lula-directed concealment, but it is relevant background. IDs: 7B.7, 7B.6

Search gap: I did not find solid 2024 evidence that Lula personally ordered prosecutors, judges, auditors, or whistleblowers to be punished or neutralized. The strongest negatives are indirect: information-control actions, pressure on digital speech, Petrobras steering, and tolerance of an indicted minister.
